joint: No felt pain. The engine’s pain number never reaches a being. Harm reaches it as the name of what happened, a lower health band and a weight in its choice (set at intensity 2, not felt); surprise goes with harm when it was unexpected, and reading surprise as pain’s channel is the owner’s call. Intensity only goes down. Whether the weight should hold only gains is the owner’s choice (V-1), for a live test.

growth: which stand-in means “distorted logic” (surprise after the answer, or a low harm guess before it), and whether a negative weight is pain at all. The owner chooses the reading.
